sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use the original repository root installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24.19.0; mobile/node_modules/vitest is absent. No installation or source-tree writes.

Minimal node config omits mobile setupFiles (only sets IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT=true), react-test-renderer warning filter, TSX inclusion and oxc.tsconfig=false. Reviewed closure has no React/TSX, app tsconfig or runtime aliases. No full mobile configuration or typecheck equivalence claimed.
description: Five unchanged original mobile capability advisory delivery and stale-session cases.
isolationRationale: All runtime imports read through protocol-version, skill-install-capability and remote-server-update. Constants, arrays, Set/WeakSet, fake Promise requests and console warnings only. RpcResponse/UpdateStatus imports type-only and erased. No actual socket, host, filesystem, agent or model requests. Minimal config is not a sandbox.
testEvidenceBoundary: Original five cases only. Two negative vi.waitFor assertions can pass before async settlement; do not count them as comprehensive stale-session fence proof. Actual transports marking ambiguous delivery, successful/explicitly refused advisory payloads, mixed hosts and candidate parity remain separate obligations.
